    • check

      public int check(TrackSectorDevice device)
      Check for RDOS catalog. Note that it might be DOS ordered -or- physical sector (13-sector disks). The testForCatalogCode() method essentially validates sector ordering is correct. Returns sectors per track (13 or 16).

    • testForCatalogCode

      public boolean testForCatalogCode(TrackSectorDevice device, int track, int sector)
      This is (hopefully) the determinant of correct sector ordering. Sector 1 (16-sector image) and 9 (13-sector image) get mapped differently between DO and PO disks.
